market_education.summary_en: US stocks rallied broadly today, with the NASDAQ up 7.0% and the S&P 500 up 5.1%, and tech and semiconductor stocks led the way. Strength was broad across AI-infrastructure and chip names such as NVDA, MU, MRVL, CRDO and DELL, and many showed volume surges, which suggests big institutional buyers were stepping in rather than a thin rally. No news headlines were provided for today, so we can't name a specific trigger, but this kind of broad, high-volume move usually reflects a shift in big-picture sentiment such as interest-rate expectations or AI spending outlooks.
market_education.summary_zh: 美股今日全面急升，納指大漲7.0%，標普500指數亦升5.1%，以科技及半導體板塊領漲。NVDA、MU、MRVL、CRDO、DELL等AI基建及晶片股普遍走強，不少個股更出現成交量急增，反映資金屬機構主導入市，而非淡市中的虛升。由於今日未有提供相關新聞標題，暫難確定具體催化因素，但如此廣泛且量價齊升的升勢，通常源於利率預期或AI資本開支前景等宏觀情緒轉變。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: A risk-on rally happens when investors feel confident and move money out of safe assets into riskier ones like tech stocks, pushing broad indexes sharply higher. A rally is more trustworthy when many stocks rise on heavy trading volume, because that shows large investors are taking part. For a trader, it's often a good moment to put idle cash to work in the strongest stocks, while keeping stop-losses in place in case the move reverses.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 所謂「風險偏好回升」（Risk-On），是指投資者信心轉強，將資金由避險資產轉投科技股等較高風險資產，帶動大市指數急升。若升勢由大量個股配合成交放大推動，可信度會更高，因為這顯示大型機構資金正積極參與。對交易者而言，這通常是把閒置現金投入最強勢股份的好時機，但仍應設好止蝕位，以防升勢逆轉。
